plugins.microphonePermission: Northstar Recovery uses your microphone when you join a meeting with audio or video.

plugins.photosPermission: Northstar Recovery uses your photo library so you can set an optional profile photo.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Northstar uses your location to sort meetings by distance and, if you opt in, to send and receive nearby SOS support alerts. Only a coarse, city-level location is ever stored.

plugins.contactsPermission: Northstar uses your contacts only to help you text an invite to friends you choose. Your contacts are never uploaded or shared.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Northstar Recovery uses your photo library so you can set an optional profile photo.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Northstar Recovery uses your location to sort meetings by distance and, if you opt in, to send and receive nearby SOS peer support alerts. Only a coarse, city-level location is ever stored.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Northstar Recovery accesses your contacts only when you choose to text an invitation to friends. Your contacts remain on your device and are never uploaded or shared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Northstar Recovery uses your microphone when you choose to join an interactive recovery meeting with audio.
